name: Taima Gakuen no Shugo Hime ~Youma ni Juurin Sareta Shoujo-tachi no Seitokai Shikkoubu~
original_name: 退魔学園の守護姫～妖魔に蹂躙された乙女たちの生徒会執行部～
source:
St. Michele Girls Academy is the land's most renowned mission school, where elite young women train in the ancient ways of the Taimashi -- the banishing of evil spirits. 

Long ago, the land was nearly ruined by a devil called Akikage, who was banished by Taimashi of generations past. Even now, he drew his strength from a mysterious girl, plotting his return. 

Three students, leaders among the school, held the title of "Protectors". 

This is their story. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE164430.html]DLsite English[/url]]
